scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,ADMIN,CONSUMER,AI -c green,blue,magenta,yellow "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix admin" "npm run dev --prefix consumer" "cd ai-service && (source .venv/bin/activate || .venv\\Scripts\\activate) && python run.py"
scripts.build: concurrently -n BACKEND,ADMIN,CONSUMER,AI -c green,blue,magenta,yellow "npm run build --prefix backend" "npm run build --prefix admin" "npm run build --prefix consumer" "npm run build --prefix ai-service"
scripts.start: concurrently -n BACKEND,ADMIN,CONSUMER,AI -c green,blue,magenta,yellow "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix admin" "npm run preview --prefix consumer" "cd ai-service && (source .venv/bin/activate || .venv\\Scripts\\activate) && python run.py"
